subject.title: Control UI: Model provider display shows original config value instead of normalized value (e.g., 'bailian' vs 'zai')

question: Should Control UI canonicalize provider aliases in derived Sessions/Usage display, query, CSV export, and aggregate keys, or show configured aliases with canonical context?
rationale: The source-level defect is clear, but the permanent behavior affects user-visible provider identity, exported data, and aggregate grouping semantics.

options.title: Canonicalize derived UI surfaces
options.body: Use the existing provider alias contract for display, filters, suggestions, CSV, and aggregate keys while leaving stored config/session fields untouched.

options.title: Show alias plus canonical context
options.body: Display configured aliases with canonical hints or tooltips, accepting wider UI copy and test surface.

options.title: Preserve raw aliases
options.body: Document that Control UI reflects stored provider keys and accept the inconsistency with canonical provider matching.

recommendation.title: Canonicalize derived UI surfaces
recommendation.body: Use the existing provider alias contract for display, filters, suggestions, CSV, and aggregate keys while leaving stored config/session fields untouched.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history in the Usage UI split and provider alias canonicalization surfaces.
